title: CardBenefit
description: Schema for a single insurance/protection benefit offered by a card issuer's plan. One JSON object per (issuer, card, benefit_type) combination.

card_name.description: The specific card product this benefit applies to, e.g. 'Sapphire Preferred'.

benefit_type.description: Which of the three supported benefit categories this record describes.

coverage_window_days.description: Number of days after the purchase during which the item remains eligible for coverage. Null for trip_delay_insurance, which uses delay_threshold_hours instead.

coverage_window_basis.description: What the coverage_window_days is measured from. For trip_delay_insurance this may instead be expressed via delay_threshold_hours.

delay_threshold_hours.description: For trip_delay_insurance only: minimum delay length (in hours) required to trigger eligibility. Null for non-travel benefits.

max_annual_amount.description: Maximum aggregate reimbursement per cardmember per 12-month/calendar-year period, if capped separately from the per-claim limit.

max_claims_per_period.description: Maximum number of claims allowed within a stated period (e.g. 2 claims per 12 months), if applicable.

eligible_categories.description: Purchase/transaction categories this benefit applies to, e.g. ['electronics', 'appliances', 'clothing'] or ['common_carrier_travel'].

required_evidence.description: Documents/evidence a claimant must provide, e.g. ['original_receipt', 'card_statement', 'police_report'].

exclusions.description: Item types, categories, or circumstances explicitly not covered.

claim_filing_deadline_days.description: Number of days from the incident within which a claim must be filed with the benefit administrator.

payment_requirement.description: How much of the purchase/trip cost must have been charged to the eligible card for the benefit to apply.

retrieved_note.description: Free-text note on where/how this figure was sourced, for traceability back to the issuer's Guide to Benefits.

source.description: Provenance metadata — required so every rule in the RAG corpus/eligibility engine can be traced back to an authoritative source, since benefit terms change over time and per-card variants exist.
